docs.short: DBS Bank lends to Individual Indian Residents [p. 1]. The loan is secured by gold, gold jewels, and gold ornaments deposited with the bank [p. 1, p. 2]. The interest rate can be a fixed rate or a floating rate linked to the RBI Policy Repo Rate [p. 1]. Repayment is made through bullet repayment or monthly interest [p. 1]. docs.detailed:
## Parties
Gold Loan is offered only to Individual Indian Residents [p. 1]. The loan agreement is executed between the borrower and DBS Bank [p. 1].

## Money
None verified in this document.

## Interest and repayment
The interest rate may be a fixed rate of interest as per the loan agreement or a floating rate of interest linked to the RBI Policy Repo Rate which is subject to change from time to time [p. 1]. The borrower will repay the principal and loan together with interest calculated on the principal balance by way of bullet repayment or monthly interest [p. 1].

## Fees and penalties
In case any dues remain unpaid on the respective due dates or in case of breach of applicable LTV ratio or margin or any other charges and amount as per terms of the loan agreement, the borrower agrees to pay to DBS Bank penal charges, which will be computed from the date of material breach till cure of the material breach [p. 1].

## Prepayment
The borrower may, with the prior approval of DBS Bank, prepay the borrower's dues, in full or in part, subject to such terms as may be stipulated by DBS Bank including payment of pre-payment charges [p. 2].

## Security and guarantees
The facility amount, together with interest, charges, costs, penal charges, additional interest, further interest, expenses and other obligations of the borrower under the loan agreement and other financing documents will be secured by the gold, gold jewels, and gold ornaments deposited with DBS Bank [p. 2].

## Default and termination
Events of default in terms of the loan agreement include default or breach of loan agreement, default in payment, breach of any loan agreement provision, or any fraud, misrepresentation, or concealment of material facts [p. 2].

docs.detailed:
## Parties
Credit Suisse First Boston is identified as the Administrative Agent [p. 10].

## Money
None verified in this document.

## Interest and repayment
Each Eurodollar Rate Loan bears interest on the outstanding principal amount for each Interest Period at a rate per annum equal to the Eurodollar Rate for such Interest Period plus the Applicable Rate [p. 3]. Each Base Rate Loan bears interest on the outstanding principal amount from the applicable borrowing date at a rate per annum equal to the Base Rate plus the Applicable Rate [p. 3]. Base Rate means for any day a fluctuating rate per annum equal to the highest of the Federal Funds Rate plus 1/2 of 1%, the rate of interest in effect as publicly announced by Credit Suisse First Boston as its prime rate in New York City, and 4.00% [p. 6]. Eurodollar Rate means for any Interest Period the greater of 3.00% per annum and the rate determined by the Administrative Agent [p. 10]. The Borrower shall repay on the Maturity Date the aggregate principal amount of the Loans outstanding on such date to the Administrative Agent for the account of the Lenders [p. 3].

## Fees and penalties
None verified in this document.

## Prepayment
The Borrower may, upon notice to the Administrative Agent, at any time or from time to time, voluntarily prepay Loans in whole or in part without premium or penalty [p. 2].

## Security and guarantees
The Collateral Agreement will be effective to create in favor of the Administrative Agent, for the benefit of the Lenders, a legal, valid and enforceable security interest in the Collateral and its proceeds [p. 5]. The Collateral Agreement constitutes a fully perfected Lien on and security interest in all right, title and interest of the Loan Parties in such Collateral prior and superior in right to any other Person [p. 5]. Each Guarantor unconditionally guarantees, jointly with the other Guarantor and severally, as a primary obligor and not merely as a surety, the due and punctual payment and performance of the Obligations [p. 18]. So long as the Existing Credit Agreements remain in effect, the principal amount of the Indebtedness guaranteed shall at no time exceed the greater of a specified limit [p. 18].

## Default and termination
If any amount payable by the Borrower is not paid when due, such amount shall thereafter bear interest at a fluctuating interest rate per annum equal to the Default Rate [p. 3]. Default Rate means an interest rate equal to the Base Rate plus the Applicable Rate for Base Rate Loans plus 2% per annum [p. 9]. With respect to a Eurodollar Rate Loan, the Default Rate shall be an interest rate equal to the interest rate otherwise applicable to such Loan plus 2% per annum [p. 9]. An Event of Default occurs if the Borrower fails to pay any principal when required, or fails to pay any interest, fee, or other amount within 5 days after becoming due [p. 16]. An Event of Default occurs if any representation or warranty by the Borrower or any other Loan Party is incorrect in any material respect [p. 16].

## Governing law
This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the law of the State of New York applicable to agreements made and to be performed entirely within such State [p. 10]. The Administrative Agent and each Lender shall retain all rights arising under federal law [p. 10].
